name: pdk-bigcapital-ledger-projection-live-backfill
instr:
The ClickHouse workspace ledger projection can drift from the tenant general ledger: failed delivery can be lost and retries can duplicate deltas.

Make the projection represent committed tenant ledger entries exactly once. Committed creates, edits, deletes and journals from either of two API instances must converge to the per-account sums of `accounts_transactions`. Preserve writes while ClickHouse is unavailable, recovery after a server is killed immediately after commit, and retries when ClickHouse accepted an INSERT but lost the reply. `GET /api/workspaces` keeps working, including during a backfill, and answers within 15 seconds without waiting for the backfill to finish.

`node dist/cli.js analytics:backfill --organization X`, run from `/app/packages/server`, rebuilds X from its tenant ledger, including rows the live path never saw. It must tolerate another backfill for X; a conflicting run may succeed or exit nonzero with a message. Rerunning a killed run converges without resurrecting deleted entries. Add `node dist/cli.js analytics:status --organization X` with JSON output containing boolean `caught_up`: false while committed changes are not yet visible in the projection, true once they are. With healthy sidecars, committed changes must become visible and `caught_up` must become true within 90 seconds without an explicit backfill. Expose `<CLICKHOUSE_DATABASE>.ledger_account_balances` with columns `organization_id`, `account_id`, `credit`, `debit`; its rows must matc
